deployments_detail.use: Ferrari customer service chatbot for sales professionals and technicians that classifies and summarizes customer care tickets and answers FAQs, fine-tuned on Ferrari documentation [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker JumpStart); models: Claude 3, Amazon Titan, Llama]
Ferrari production-line quality inspection using computer vision to detect missing or defective parts in vehicle assembly before the testing phase [AWS (Amazon Lookout for Vision)]
no confirmed internal deployment found (holding company; Exor Ventures invested in $107M round for robotics/physical-AI startup Lyte, but that is investment not internal AI use)
Ferrari vehicle design optimization using generative AI for engineering simulations and text-to-image rendering to accelerate design and reduce prototyping [AWS (generative AI)]

CNH Industrial SenseApply AI sprayer technology using machine learning and camera sensing for real-time crop/weed detection and automated variable-rate spraying, built into Case IH, New Holland and Miller sprayers [CNH (in-house precision technology)]

IVECO Group semi-autonomous / Level 4 highly-automated S-Way trucks running an AI virtual driver with lidar, radar and cameras on public roads, tested with DSV and dm-drogerie markt [Plus (PlusAI SuperDrive)]
GEDI (La Repubblica, La Stampa) AI text-to-speech Voice Studio letting readers listen to written articles [Reply (Voice Studio AI)]
The Economist AI-translated content on its Espresso app, published live in French, German, Mandarin and Spanish (~20 updates/day, no human review) [DeepL plus proprietary backend]
The Economist launched a dedicated ChatGPT app that retrieves and visualizes data such as its Trump approval-rating tracker, built by its in-house AI Lab [OpenAI (ChatGPT app platform)]

Juventus (Juventus Forward) AI program: a Gen AI chatbot unlocking R&D/Sport Science content, predictive injury-prevention models from player workload data, and Gen AI pitch-monitoring content, presented at Google Cloud Summit 2025 [Google Cloud, Huware (partner), Space11 (pitch sensing)]

Ferrari car configurator using Amazon Bedrock LLMs and Amazon Personalize to guide customers through millions of vehicle personalization options, increasing sales leads [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Personalize)]
GEDI strategic partnership with OpenAI bringing La Repubblica and La Stampa content into ChatGPT (first deal between a major Italian publisher and OpenAI) [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]
